title: ICAI Tender Guidelines: Important Update for Practising CAs (12-10-2026)
content:
# ICAI Tender Guidelines: Important Update for Practising CAs (12-10-2026)

Ek important update hai! The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) ne practicing Chartered Accountants ke liye tenders se related kuch naye guidelines announce kiye hain, effective from October 12, 2026. Yeh guidelines professional services mein fair practice aur appropriate remuneration ensure karne ke liye laye gaye hain.

Yeh hain kuch key highlights:

*   **Mandatory Minimum Fees for Reserved Services:** Agar tender professional services ke liye hai jo exclusively Chartered Accountants ke liye statutory-reserved hain, toh CA us tender ko tab tak respond nahi kar sakte jab tak usme minimum fees specify na ki gayi ho. Agar minimum fee prescribed hai, toh quoted fee usse kam nahi ho sakti.
*   **Definition of "Minimum Fee":** Isme "estimated fee," "professional fee," ya "average fee" jaise terms bhi shamil hain, irrespective of the terminology used in the tender document.
*   **Services Not Exclusively Reserved:** Jo services exclusively CAs ke liye reserved nahi hain, unke liye CAs tender respond kar sakte hain, chahe minimum fee prescribed ho ya na ho, aur chahe sirf CAs ko invite kiya gaya ho ya nahi.
*   **No Extremely Low Quotes:** ICAI ne clearly kaha hai ki professional fees assignment ke size, value, volume, manpower requirement, aur nature of work ke commensurate honi chahiye, aur extremely low fee quotes discourage kiye gaye hain. Reverse bidding, jisme minimum fee se kam quote kiya jaata hai, allowed nahi hai.
*   **Mandatory Cost Sheet:** Har tender response ke liye, members ko ek cost sheet maintain karni hogi jisme estimated expenditure (jaise number of persons involved aur estimated working hours) ki details hongi. ICAI in documents ko kabhi bhi request kar sakta hai.
*   **Exclusion:** Ye guidelines un cases par apply nahi honge jahaan practising members/firms se individual letters ke through quotations invite ki jaati hain.

Yeh guidelines Chartered Accountants Act, 1949 ke Section 15(2)(fa) ke under issue kiye gaye hain aur 7th April, 2016 ki earlier Guideline No. 1-CA(7)/03/2016 ke conjunction mein padhe jaane chahiye.
